name: lyricreel
description: Generate synced lyric videos for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and TikTok

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend start"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix remotion run typecheck
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix remotion install
